Georgian translator/Notarion 🇬🇪🇮🇱
Hi dear group,

My husband and I got married in Georgia, we have the marriage certificate with an apostille. We went to Misrad Hapnim and they asked for a translation done in Israel.

Do you know a notarion that can help us with this?

Do you know how much they charge by law?

TIA 🙏🏻
